mapper.select: SELECT TS.SERVICE_ID, TS.WORK_CD, TS.COMPANY_ID, TS.BRANCH_ID, TS.MEMBER_ID, TS.GOVT_ID, TS.PROC_ST, TS.JUDGE_ST, TN.CARID_NO, TN.REQ_CAR_NO as CAR_NO, TN.OWNER_NM, PKG_COMMON.FN_DECRYPT(TN.MPHONE_NO) AS MPHONE_NO, TN.REGIST_DATE FROM TR_SERVICE TS JOIN TR_NEWCAR TN ON TS.SERVICE_ID = TN.SERVICE_ID WHERE TRUNC(TN.REGIST_DATE) = TRUNC(SYSDATE) AND TS.PROC_ST = 'P_END' UNION ALL SELECT TS.SERVICE_ID, TS.WORK_CD, TS.COMPANY_ID, TS.BRANCH_ID, TS.MEMBER_ID, TS.GOVT_ID, TS.PROC_ST, TS.JUDGE_ST, TN.CARID_NO, TN.REQ_CAR_NO as CAR_NO, TN.OWNER_NM, PKG_COMMON.FN_DECRYPT(TN.MPHONE_NO) AS MPHONE_NO, TN.REGIST_DATE FROM TR_SERVICE TS JOIN TR_NEWCAR TN ON TS.SERVICE_ID = TN.SERVICE_ID WHERE TRUNC(TN.REGIST_DATE) = TRUNC(SYSDATE) AND TS.PROC_ST = 'S_WAIT'
SELECT MEMBER_NM AS SPECIALIST_NM, PKG_COMMON.FN_DECRYPT(MPHONE_NO) AS SPECIALIST_HP_NO FROM TM_MEMBER_DT WHERE MEMBER_ID = #{MEMBER_ID}

SELECT TS.SERVICE_ID, TS.CAR_NO, TS.PROC_ST, TS.JUDGE_ST, TS.COMPANY_ID, TN.REGIST_DATE, TS.MEMBER_ID, TCD.CUSTOMER_NM, DECODE (TN.PROC_CD, 'C', PKG_COMMON.FN_DECRYPT(TN.MPHONE_NO), DECODE(TN.TASK_CD, 'LEASE', PKG_COMMON.FN_DECRYPT(TOI.DSIGN_HP_NO), PKG_COMMON.FN_DECRYPT(TN.MPHONE_NO))) AS MPHONE_NO, TN.REQ_CAR_NO AS REQ_CAR_NO FROM TR_SERVICE TS, TR_NEWCAR TN, TR_CARNO_DETACH TCD, TR_OWNERINFO TOI WHERE TS.SERVICE_ID = TN.SERVICE_ID AND TS.SERVICE_ID = TCD.SERVICE_ID AND TCD.SERVICE_ID = TOI.SERVICE_ID(+) AND TS.PROC_ST IN ('P_REQ', 'PBEND') AND TO_CHAR(TN.REGIST_DATE,'YYYYMMDD') = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE + 1, 'YYYYMMDD') AND TS.WORK_CD = '010' AND TOI.SEQ = 0

SELECT TS.SERVICE_ID, TN.REQ_CAR_NO, TS.PROC_ST, TS.JUDGE_ST, TS.COMPANY_ID, TN.REGIST_DATE, TS.MEMBER_ID, TCD.CUSTOMER_NM, DECODE (TN.PROC_CD, 'C', PKG_COMMON.FN_DECRYPT(TN.MPHONE_NO), DECODE(TN.TASK_CD, 'LEASE', PKG_COMMON.FN_DECRYPT(TOI.DSIGN_HP_NO), PKG_COMMON.FN_DECRYPT(TN.MPHONE_NO))) AS MPHONE_NO, TP.VBANK_NO AS ACQ_VBANK_NO, TP.PAY_AMT AS ACQ_PAY_AMT FROM TR_SERVICE TS, TR_NEWCAR TN, TR_CARNO_DETACH TCD, TR_PAYMENT TP, TR_OWNERINFO TOI WHERE TS.SERVICE_ID = TN.SERVICE_ID AND TS.SERVICE_ID = TCD.SERVICE_ID AND TCD.SERVICE_ID = TP.SERVICE_ID AND TP.SERVICE_ID = TOI.SERVICE_ID(+) AND TS.PROC_ST NOT IN ('RET', 'DEL', 'END', 'D_CON', 'A_RET', 'P_RET') AND TN.CARD_YN = 'Y' AND TN.CARD_PAY_YN = 'N' AND TO_CHAR(TN.REGIST_DATE,'YYYYMMDD') = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDD') AND TS.WORK_CD = '010' AND TP.PAY_KD = 'ACQ' AND TP.VBANK_NO IS NOT NULL AND TP.PAY_AMT != 0 AND TOI.SEQ = 0
SELECT MEMBER_NM, COMPANY_ID, BRACNH_ID, MEMBER_GB, TEL_NO, MPHONE_NO FROM TM_MEMBER_DT WHERE MEMBER_ID = #{MEMBER_ID}
mapper.update: UPDATE TR_SERVICE SET PROC_ST = 'S_REQ', JUDGE_ST = 'S_REQ', UPD_DATE = SYSDATE, UPD_USER = 'SCHEDULAR' WHERE SERVICE_ID = #{SERVICE_ID}
